summary: Created `OS Comparison Root CA` on node1 and installed it as a trusted AlmaLinux system certificate authority. Trust and CA signing functionality persisted across a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Generated a 4096-bit RSA root CA valid for 10 years.
Stored its private key at `/etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key` with root-only mode 0600.
Installed its certificate at `/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt` and refreshed system trust.
Verified the CA metadata, constraints, key match, trust listing, and system-bundle validation.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified its boot identity changed.
After restart, verified the system was running and successfully validated a newly signed test certificate through the system trust bundle.

evidence.requirement: Create and install `OS Comparison Root CA` as a trusted system CA
evidence.summary: Shows the initial state, secure CA creation and installation, CA:TRUE/key-signing constraints, matching private key, trust-database listing, and successful system-bundle verification.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart and recovered CA trust
evidence.summary: Captures healthy pre-restart trust and boot ID, restart acknowledgement and connection interruption, changed post-restart boot ID, running system state, persisted CA files, trust listing, and successful end-to-end validation of a certificate signed after restart.
